chunks: We shall punish them whether We take you away,

key_terms.مُنْتَقِمُونَ: We are avengers / We exact retribution

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah says He will take the Prophet away and punish the disbelievers?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Az-Zukhruf, Allah reassures the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) of His power to remove him from their sight—interpreted by Shia scholars as either his death or the Ascension (I'raj)—followed by divine retribution against the disbelievers. This highlights the certainty of Allah's vengeance, reinforcing the theme that the Prophet's fate is in Allah's hands and that the rejecters will face the consequences of their denial.
